summary: Gate for supervision: one question, approving r209 and r210 and retiring r162 and r163.
questions: Are the supervision lines approved as drafted? Removed (retired): [r162] **When** a question of an initiative names a term of the glossary or a glossary-proposal, `work run` shall leave the question for the person, giving it to no session under a delegation; [r163] **Where** the request an initiative fulfils gives a delegation, `work run` shall give each question of the initiative that names neither a term of the glossary nor a glossary-proposal to a session of its own, given the delegation, the files that one question names and nothing else, which answers the question if the delegation covers it and leaves it for the person otherwise. Added: [r209] **When** a question of an initiative is a question of a glossary-proposal, `work run` shall leave the question for the person, giving it to no session under a delegation. (replaces r162; your answer of 2026-10-29: only a glossary-proposal counts.) [r210] **Where** the request an initiative fulfils gives a delegation, `work run` shall give each question of the initiative that is not a question of a glossary-proposal, whatever words it uses, to a session of its own, given the delegation, the files that one question names and nothing else, which answers the question if the delegation covers it and leaves it for the person otherwise. (replaces r163.) No glossary term and no decision changes. Readings: (a) [recommended] approve r209 and r210 as drafted, retiring r162 and r163; (b) change their lines, saying how.
